title: The Cartesian Shortcut: Re-evaluate Vision Reasoning in Polar Coordinate Space
abstract: arXiv:2605.09883v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As current Multimodal Large Language Models rapidly saturate canonical visual reasoning benchmarks, a key question emerges: do these strong scores genuinely reflect robust visual understanding? We identify a pervasive vulnerability, the Cartesian Shortcut: models frequently discretize the orthogonal grid-based layouts prevalent in visual reasoning benchmarks into explicit textual coordinates, offloading reasoning from visual perception to text-based deduction. To re-evaluate visual reasoning when this shortcut is unavailable, we introduce Polaris-Bench, which re-formulates 53 visual reasoning tasks in Polar coordinate space with paired Cartesian counterparts that preserve task semantics, disrupting the orthogonal structure that models exploit. Comprehensive evaluation across $14$ state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that frontier models achieving $69$--$83\%$ on Cartesian layouts collapse to $31$--$39\%$ on Polar equivalents. Moreove

translated_title: 笛卡尔捷径：在极坐标空间中重新评估视觉推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.09883v3 通告类型：replace-cross。摘要：随着当前多模态大语言模型迅速在经典视觉推理基准上趋于饱和，一个关键问题浮现：这些亮眼的成绩是否真正反映了稳健的视觉理解能力？我们发现了一种普遍存在的漏洞——“笛卡尔捷径”：模型经常将视觉推理基准中普遍存在的正交网格布局离散化为显式的文本坐标，从而把推理从视觉感知转嫁为基于文本的演绎。为了在该捷径不可用时重新评估视觉推理能力，我们提出了 Polaris-Bench，它将 53 个视觉推理任务在极坐标空间中重新表述，并配有保留任务语义的成对笛卡尔对应版本，从而破坏了模型所利用的正交结构。对 14 个最先进 MLLM 的全面评估表明，在笛卡尔布局上取得 69%–83% 成绩的前沿模型，在等效的极坐标版本上骤降至 31%–39%。此外……
tldr: 论文揭示多模态大模型普遍依赖“笛卡尔捷径”，即将网格布局转化为文本坐标来代替真正的视觉推理，并提出将 53 个任务改写为极坐标形式的新基准 Polaris-Bench，使前沿模型成绩从 69%–83% 骤降至 31%–39%，暴露出其视觉理解能力的脆弱性。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals a "Cartesian Shortcut" vulnerability in MLLMs—converting orthogonal grid layouts into explicit textual coordinates instead of reasoning visually—and introduces Polaris-Bench, which reformulates 53 visual reasoning tasks in polar coordinates, causing frontier models' performance to collapse from 69–83% to 31–39%.
